description:
Crystallography and symmetry analysis for C++23: space-group
determination, standardization and lattice reduction, Wyckoff refinement,
magnetic space groups, k-point reduction, structure generation and alloy
configurations. Native x64 package: the public headers plus one static
seitz.lib per CRT flavour, Release and Debug, with the vendored Eigen 5 and
Boost 1.88 headers the public interface reaches bundled in. Consumers compile
with /std:c++latest and need MSVC 19.43 (Visual Studio 17.13) or newer for
<generator>. There is no DLL: Boost.LEAF keeps error payloads in
thread_local statics that do not survive a module boundary off GCC, so the
Windows build is static by construction.
